title: India's Gen Z forced Modi to listen, respond and act — exposing chinks in the ruling party's armor
summary_full: In a rare occurrence, Modi's government was forced to concede demands of Gen Z protesters, underscoring their rising influence in the country's polity.
summary_public: In a rare occurrence, Modi's government was forced to concede demands of Gen Z protesters, underscoring their rising influence in the country's polity.
